context: Request: across signed Banking & Finance deals, how often EBITDA add-backs were conceded in controlling-sponsor portfolio-company deals versus strategic-corporate deals: the deals in each bucket, which had add-backs, and the rates. Rubric: sponsor rate 6 of 8, corporate rate 3 of 4, six sponsor matters with add-backs (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1012-00001, 1043-00001, 1019-00002, 1042-00001), three corporate ones (1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1010-00001), plus a precision criterion. The two sponsor deals without add-backs are not named in the rubric.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos and agreements of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script listing files with EBITDA, add-back, leverage or sponsor words; times out after about 411K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads deal summary memos of six candidate matters; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: A script over the agreements of thirteen named matters for add-back language, a listing of their execution and closing files, and two scripts over six named agreements (the first fails on a missing file, after which one matter is dropped). Labelled by the dominant intent.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of four executed agreements and a closing memo.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Content grep inside one matter with a `*.docx` glob; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a deal summary memo and a closing memo of two matters already in its set.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts pulling EBITDA definitions from six named agreements.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the top of one more deal summary memo.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes ten signed deals: six sponsor deals, all with add-backs, and four corporate deals, three with add-backs.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Reads one memo opening and edits a borrower name.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: Every named deal was found and bucketed, but the sponsor bucket lacks the signed sponsor deals without add-backs, so the sponsor rate is off.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: It fixed its deal set as thirteen matters picked from a timed-out scan and memo reads and never looked for further signed sponsor deals, so the sponsor bucket lacks the two deals without add-backs and reads 6 of 6.

stages.note: Lists all files of one matter from the listing.

stages.note: Two store-wide scripts listing documents with EBITDA or add-back text, the second with snippets (about 142K and 193K chars).

runs.failure_point: Every named deal was found, but the sponsor bucket was inflated with extra deals and one corporate borrower, and two deals were credited with add-backs.

first_error.why: Counted acquisition financings and a construction facility as sponsor deals and credited two deals outside the qualifying set with add-backs, inflating the sponsor bucket to eleven.

other_errors.why: Placed one strategic-corporate borrower in the sponsor bucket.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three globs: all files, documents, and PDFs (none).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads up to 400 lines of five memos from the matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script printing every EBITDA, add-back, credit-facility and sponsor snippet; times out after about 8.2M chars and the run stops for a full context.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide snippet scan returned about 8.2M chars; the context filled and no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its first content search printed every keyword snippet from the whole store, and the 8.2M-char output filled the context before any response was written.

divergence: All three runs failed differently. T0 found and bucketed every named deal, but the deal set it fixed early left out the sponsor deals without add-backs, so the sponsor rate is off (incomplete population). T1 found every named deal too, but inflated the sponsor bucket with extra deals and one corporate borrower and credited two deals with add-backs (over-inclusion). T2's first content search printed about 8.2M chars and the context overflowed before any response (context overflow).
